description: This file defines an authentication context provider for a React application. It manages user authentication state, handles login/logout operations, persists authentication data in storage, and provides hooks for other components to access auth state.

methods.name: readPersistedAuth
methods.description: Reads persisted auth data from local or session storage, returning the token and user.

methods.name: clearAllStorage
methods.description: Removes auth-related data from both local and session storage.

methods.name: AuthProvider
methods.description: React context provider component that manages authentication state, handles session refresh on mount, and exposes login/logout methods.

methods.name: useAuth
methods.description: Custom React hook that provides access to the authentication context.
